characters.name: Rovan Vey
characters.title: Duke
characters.status: A duke in name only at the opening
characters.rise_to_power: Protected other cities and their ships from pirates.
characters.initial_condition: Depleted fleet, few resources, unable to pay his soldiers despite their sacrifices.
characters.motivation: Resents wealthy rulers who benefited from his protection and declares he will define his own future and take what is his.
characters.key_quote: I will define my own future. We sail for Auric Reach. I will take what is mine.

military.recruitment: Funded and equipped from seized resources; veterans drill recruits

characters.exclusive_knowledge: Secret Type C crafting knowledge gained through experience

visual_concept.appearance: Adult man, black hair with silver streak, short dark beard, navy officer coat with bronze shoulder armour, muted red scarf

characters.uniform_standard: Veymarch military base-layer cloth, capes and tabards are crimson red; bronze armour stays bronze, and Type C armour stays silver. Rovan’s navy outer officer coat and the general’s olive outer coat remain distinct.

characters.name: General Grievous
characters.relationship_to_rovan: Shares the fleet accounts, hears his frustration, and accompanies his seizure and campaign.

visual_concept.status: provisional project artwork, not established species or biography
visual_concept.appearance: Older bald human officer with a grey moustache, dark olive coat and bronze epaulettes

characters.uniform_standard: Veymarch military base-layer cloth, capes and tabards are crimson red; bronze armour stays bronze, and Type C armour stays silver. Rovan’s navy outer officer coat and the general’s olive outer coat remain distinct.

characters.name: Rovan’s five honour-guard captains

equipment.armour_construction: Practical man-made brushed silver with tool marks and restrained machined details; sealed continuous coverage with no joints or gaps.
equipment.armour_detail: Brushed silver shells with narrow aged brass edging, small fittings and chased geometric details. Crimson enamel badges show Veymarch’s silver broken shield and eight-point star.

characters.mobility: Drift along magnetic fields and leap between ships
characters.uniform_standard: Continuous silver coverage with no joints or gaps. Crimson capes, sashes and tabards are worn over the sealed armour; cloth is never a gap in the metal.

characters.title: Ruler of Auric Reach
characters.current_action: Dispatches three capital ships toward Rovan

visual_concept.status: provisional artwork; name and biography are unestablished
visual_concept.appearance: An adult ruler in gold and navy, partly shadowed, beneath the Auric Reach balance banner

characters.name: The schooner courier
characters.role: Unnamed Veymarch messenger who warns Rovan that three Auric Reach Bastions are approaching.

visual_concept.appearance: Young adult human messenger with short brown hair, flying goggles pushed onto forehead, worn bronze flight jacket over a crimson base layer; no silver armour.

characters.uniform_standard: Practical bronze and leather flight gear over crimson cloth; Veymarch affiliation.
